system.description:
Academics represents education and general knowledge beyond rudimentary schooling — the broad sweep of the humanities. With it you can express artistic criticism, debate the classics, consider philosophy, indulge in cultural studies, and recognize historical, artistic and cultural references while researching or developing a critique.

Calling on Academics may require a Mental or Social Challenge to determine your exact competence. You may direct your studies by choosing a specific field, such as Art Criticism, Classical Studies, History, Journalism or Theology.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
